title: The loud forget; the humble uphold
paragraphs: The loud forget; the humble uphold
Some crowns shine brighter because someone unseen kept polishing them.

Matthew 25:40 (NRSV)
“Truly I tell you, just as you did it to one of the least of these who are members of my family, you did it to me.”
The unnoticed hands in your line literally mirror the “least of these” whom Christ identifies with Himself — the invisible sustainers of heaven’s throne.
